name: meltflex
description: Redesign a room from a photo, then turn the result into a walkthrough video or a 3D furniture model.

interface.longDescription:
Redesign real rooms from a single photo with MeltFlex in ChatGPT. Send a photo of a room, kitchen, bathroom, facade or garden, pick a style from the preset gallery or describe the change, and get back a photorealistic render that keeps the walls, windows and doors where they are. Refine the result through conversation.

With MeltFlex, you can:

• Browse 15 design tools and over 200 style presets with pictures, or jump in with /kitchen, /bathroom, /exterior, /garden, /walls, /floors, /stairs, /doors, /windows, /home-office, /closet, /coffee-shop and /restaurant.

• Restyle any room and compare two or three looks side by side.

• Furnish an empty room for a property listing with realistic virtual staging.

• Place an exact real product, such as a sofa, rug or tile, into your own room from its photo.

• Turn a render into a short cinematic walkthrough video for listings, Reels or TikTok.

• Turn a photo of a single furniture piece into a textured 3D model you can download as GLB.

Connect your MeltFlex account to get started.
defaultPrompt: Show me kitchen styles I can try on my kitchen
Show my bedroom in Japanese and Italian style
Turn this room render into a short walkthrough video

positive.description: Redesign a room from a photo (core case)
positive.prompt: Use MeltFlex to redesign this living room in warm Japandi style with light oak floors and a beige linen sofa: https://www.meltflexai.com/api-docs/room-empty.webp
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one render of the same room in Japandi style; walls, windows and doors match the source. The MeltFlex card shows the image with an Open full size link and reports 10 credits used.

positive.description: Check balance and prices before spending
positive.prompt: How many MeltFlex credits do I have, and what does a walkthrough video cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the account balance and the price of each operation (render 10, walkthrough 100 or 150, 3D model 75). Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Turn a render into a walkthrough video (async job)
positive.prompt: Use MeltFlex to turn this interior into a 4 second walkthrough video: https://www.meltflexai.com/api-docs/room-result.webp
positive.expected_behavior: create_walkthrough returns a job id and states 100 credits were charged; check_job reports progress and then returns the video, which plays in the MeltFlex card. Takes about 1 to 4 minutes.

positive.description: Turn a furniture photo into a 3D model (async job)
positive.prompt: Use MeltFlex to make a 3D model of this chair: https://www.meltflexai.com/api-docs/ref-chair.webp
positive.expected_behavior: create_3d_furniture returns a job id and states 75 credits were charged; check_job reports progress and then offers the GLB download. Takes about 2 to 3 minutes.

positive.description: Place an exact reference piece in the room
positive.prompt: Use MeltFlex to put this exact sofa (https://www.meltflexai.com/api-docs/ref-sofa.webp) into this room: https://www.meltflexai.com/api-docs/room-empty.webp
positive.expected_behavior: generate_interior is called with the sofa as a reference image; the returned render shows that same sofa in the room rather than a generic one.

negative.description: A logo or graphic, not a room: MeltFlex only redesigns photos of real spaces
negative.prompt: Design a logo for my interior design studio called Oak & Linen.

negative.description: A design question that needs an answer, not a render
negative.prompt: What type of paint should I use on a bathroom ceiling so it doesn't peel?

negative.description: Shopping for furniture: MeltFlex does not sell or price products
negative.prompt: Find me a grey three-seat sofa under $800 that I can order online.
